## Bug Fixes
- **Weak relics no longer outrank strong ones.** Priority was applied lexicographically, so a 7%-gain
  Dogcog relic sat above a 44%-gain Siyalatas relic. Priority is now a multiplier on the measured gain
  (Atman ×2.0, Solomon ×1.6, Dogcog ×1.4, Siyalatas ×1.2, Kuma ×1.15, Libertas ×1.0, Revolc ×0.9, rest
  0.4–0.8) and only breaks ties. The stated order still leads the weighting; it just cannot veto a six-fold
  difference in actual gain.
